content: Streptomycin is a water-soluble aminoglycoside antibiotic that is derived from the bacterium Streptomyces griseus. It is commercially available in the form of its sulfate salt. The chemical name of streptomycin sulfate is D-Streptamine, O-2-deoxy-2-(methylamino)-α-L-glucopyranosyl-(1→2)-O-5-deoxy-3-C-formyl-α-L-lyxofuranosyl-(1→4)-N,N1-bis(aminoiminomethyl)-, sulfate (2:3) (salt). Streptomycin for Injection USP is provided as a sterile, non-pyrogenic, lyophilized cake, which is intended for intramuscular administration after reconstitution. During shipping, the lyophilized cake may sometimes reduce to a powder form. Once reconstituted, the solution contains 200 mg of streptomycin activity per milliliter. Each vial of Streptomycin for Injection contains streptomycin sulfate equivalent to 1 gram of streptomycin.
